description:
Probably Sudoku is a roguelike number puzzle built around Sudoku rules, powerful combos and Books with personality.

Choose from 12 Books, each with its own ability and questionable encouragement. Place numbers using Sudoku rules, build scoring combinations, and reach each puzzle's target before your turns run out. You don't have to fill every square to win.

A BOOK WORTH FINISHING
Each run spans nine chapters and 27 puzzles. Plan around clearly announced boss powers, then face one of six challenging finales on the last page. New Books draw from 22 distinct bosses. Finish a Book to earn its achievement and unlock its next Obstacle difficulty.

MAKE THE NUMBERS WORK FOR YOU
Discover 50 Bookmarks, 50 Markers and 40 consumable Buffs. Spend earned coins to strengthen your build, reward chosen squares and create combinations that turn a modest move into a much bigger score. Watch Points and multipliers build live, arrange your hand, and hold marked squares to inspect their effects.

Choose to play an ordinary puzzle or skip it for a Buff shown in advance. Boss puzzles must be played. With only two Buff slots, deciding what to keep is part of the strategy.

PAPER, PERSONALITY AND ONE MORE TRY
Browse a rotating book rack, turn flexible paper pages, and enjoy music, sound effects and tactile feedback. Adjust the audio and motion to suit you. Interactive practice teaches placement, multipliers, buying and selling, Markers and Buffs. Replay it from Settings and continue your saved Book from home.

Play without a required login. Optional rewarded videos can grant three extra turns, once per puzzle, when an ad is available and the encounter permits it.

Your next good idea is probably one number away.
reviewNotes:
Version 1.1.0 (build 15) adds an expanded 140-item catalogue, a redesigned roster of 22 bosses, previewed Buff rewards for unlimited ordinary-puzzle skips, live ordered scoring, direct marker inspection, and revised tutorial, settings, Book continuation and visual presentation. Existing saved Books retain their historical rewards and encounters. Per-Book completion awards are local achievements; existing registered Game Center achievements remain supported.

No app account, subscription or purchase is required. Game Center sign-in is optional. Complete or skip the tutorial, choose Play, select a Book and available Obstacle, then Open the Book. The Next puzzle page offers Play puzzle or Skip + Buff for ordinary puzzles. Boss encounters are mandatory. A full two-slot Buff inventory requires an explicit replacement choice before a skip can commit.

Select a number from the Hand, then a valid Sudoku square. End Turn banks the live Points x Mult score. Meet the target before turns run out; filling the full grid is not required. After meeting the target, Keep Filling allows additional clears, or Cash Out opens the Shop. Items cost only coins earned through play. New Books have nine chapters; the final encounter may introduce special completion or banking rules.

One unfinished Book is retained. Continue on the home screen resumes it; starting another asks the player to continue or abandon the current Book. Settings includes How to play, Replay tutorial, audio sliders, Reduced Motion, Privacy and Support. Practice is isolated from saved runs and makes no ad requests.

The optional rewarded-video rescue can grant three extra turns once per eligible puzzle. Retrying and playback remain manual. Declining or closing without earning the reward grants no turns; End Book remains available. Production uses live Google AdMob identifiers and the existing consent behavior. Ad availability depends on connectivity, consent and inventory. There are no in-app purchases or paid currency.
promotionalText: Sudoku rules, roguelike twists. Discover 140 items, face 22 distinct bosses, and build powerful scoring combos across Books with personality.
